sections.title: Bluetooth API
sections.description: Bluetooth device management and communication. Scan, connect, and communicate with Bluetooth devices.

sections.title: Wi-Fi API
sections.description: Wi-Fi state and control. Scan networks, manage connections, and monitor signal strength.

sections.title: Core JNI API
sections.description: Low-level JNI and Android runtime access. Direct access to native system functions.

sections.title: Permissions API
sections.description: Runtime permission handling. Request and manage app permissions easily.

sections.title: System Services & File System API
sections.description: System services and storage access. Manage files, preferences, and system settings.

sections.title: Device Information API
sections.description: Battery and device runtime information. Monitor device status and hardware info.

sections.title: Camera & Gallery API
sections.description: Media capture and selection. Take photos, record videos, and pick from gallery.

sections.title: UI Utilities API
sections.description: Android UI feedback utilities. Toasts, dialogs, and material components.

sections.title: DPI Conversion API
sections.description: Convert between Android density-independent pixels (dp) and actual pixels (px).

sections.title: Widgets API
sections.description: Custom Android UI widgets and components. Pre-built material design components for faster UI development.

sections.title: Orientation API
sections.description: Control and query device orientation. Set portrait or landscape mode, lock and unlock orientation.

sections.title: Building & Deployment
sections.description: Build and deploy AromaUI apps. Step-by-step guides for building and deploying on Android and Linux.
